scripts.start: concurrently "uv run server.py" "cd app-desktop/ && pnpm tauri dev"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently "uv run uvicorn server:app --reload --reload-exclude .venv --reload-exclude app-desktop --reload-exclude node_modules" "cd app-desktop/ && pnpm tauri dev"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently "TRITON_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=web uv run uvicorn server:app --reload --reload-exclude .venv --reload-exclude app-desktop --reload-exclude node_modules" "cd app-desktop/ && VITE_TRITON_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=web pnpm dev"
